(575)na mo ār+ya tā ra ye/sgrol ma rigs lnga'i dbang bskur la/sngags btsun pad+ma las 'brel rtsal rang lo so bzhir phyin pa na/byang rwa sgrong du bka' gdams

tei:div.tei:p: na mo ār+ya tā ra ye/ sgrol ma rigs lnga'i dbang bskur la/ sngags btsun pad+ma las 'brel rtsal rang lo so bzhir phyin pa na/ byang rwa sgrong du bka' gdams bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal bu 'brom ston rin po che'i zhing khams yi ge drug ma'i bkod pa'i gzhal yas su rje btsun mas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ slad nas mdo khams tsam du yongs su che ba'i gnas gtsang gshis rdo rje gro lod dang nye ba'i char sngon dus rgya bza' kong jo bod du phebs tshe yun ring du bzhugs pa dbu skra bkrus pa'i chu 'thor par (576)dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi rten shing shug pa'i phung po nyer brgyad kyis brten pa'i sman chu'i khar/ bdag gser sdings nas thon ste/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs su slebs pa dang spos kyi dri zhim po'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ rig pa chos nyid kyi gshis su 'byams klas pa'i rjes kyi snang char/ ljang zhing dmar ba'i kha dog kyi 'ja' gur phub pa'i dubs su rgya rje'i sras mo kong jo mi yi kha dog las 'das zhing lha yi mdog cung zad ma thob pa'i bud med sku lus phra la dkyus ring ba sku mdog dkar la cir yang 'gyur (577)ba dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' mnabs pa phyag pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar dmar ba gnyis kyis sup+ta ka bsnams pa zhig gi zhal nas sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud sku mdog gsung pa de ltar sang dro tsam gyi yun du zhal mjal ba las byung ba'i zab mo dag snang bi skor las byin rlabs dbang gi rim pa la/ rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das lhas lha la ji ltar byin gyis brlab par (578)bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ sprul pa dang sgyu ma dang 'ja' tshon dang*/ smig rgyu dang chu zla dang gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/ gsol pa/ sprul pa zhes bya ba ji lta bu/ bka' stsal pa/ sprul pa zhes bya ba yang dag pa ma yin zhing gnyis ka 'khrul ba'o/

sgyu ma ni gzhan 'khrul ba'o/ 'ja' tshon ni stong pa'o/ smig rgyu ni yul 'khrul ba'i stong pa'o/ chu zla ni rgya 'bras so/ gzugs brnyan ni dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'o/ 'khrul ba ni de bzhin tu nyon mongs pa'i khams so/ 'jam (579)dpal de lta bas na lhas lha la byin rlabs pa de dang 'dra bas 'jam dpal sprul pa sogs la thogs pa med cing thogs pa dang bral ba'o/ tha dad med cing tha dad dang bral ba'o/ de phyir rang bzhin de dang 'dra bar yid la gyis shig ces gsungs pa bzhin/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa'i ngo kha nas dpon slob gnyis kas bsam bsgom gyi rgyud kyi rten 'byung dbang bskur ba la dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ho/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bdag la dgongs/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pas (580)na/ de phyir rgyal ba'i yum du grags/ sgrol ma'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi/ ho/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob par/ dam tshig sdom pa la gnas zhing*/ byang chub sems ni mi btang na/ lha yi dkyil 'khor sbyin par bya/ lan gsum/ slob mas/ sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ byang chub bsgrod lam snying rje dang */ byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi na/ thugs rje rjes su bzung bar mjod/ lan gsum bya'o/ de nas phyi 'jug oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta up+tal ya a ham̐/ (581) skyabs sems tshogs bsags sdom bzung rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya/ nang 'jug ltar brlab pa'i rim pa rang rang gi mngon rtogs ltar byas/ dbang dngos la dang po bum pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i khams bzhugs pa'i/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlobs/ rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ sku'i dbang bskur khyod kyis longs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a tam̐ a ham̐ badz+ra sta na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sta na hūm̐/ gnyis pa rin po che'i phyag rgya'am phreng ba mgrin par bzhag ste/ āḥ gang dag phyogs bcu'i khams bzhugs (582)pa'i/

sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlobs/ rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ gsung gi dbyig tu deng gyur cig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsin+ta ma ṇi dz+wa la ni sarba ta thā ga ta a ham̐ shud+dha pa ri shud+dha ya swā hā/ gsum pa dam tshig gi phyag rgya'am ut+pal snying gar bzhag ste/ hūm̐/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlobs/ rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ thugs kyi dbyig tu deng gyur cig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes bskur ro/ rjes kyi bya ba dbang spyi dang mthun no/ sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ
